notes: This is a complete concrete class catalog for the three generated primary taxonomies and corresponding concrete TypeLoc wrappers, not a complete field schema for the entire Clang C++ API.
Decl/Stmt/Type taxonomy does not encode source language eligibility; some shared classes carry language-specific payloads and subenums.
Abstract taxonomy bases are inheritance/common-field metadata, never oneof wire variants. Some nonabstract classes have derived concrete kinds; preserve their own kind variants too.
TypeLoc logical generated taxonomy is not its exact CRTP inheritance graph; preserve source occurrence identity separately from uniqued semantic Type identity.
BuiltinType::Kind expands multiple external .def lists (OpenCL images/opaque, HLSL, SVE/RVV/PPC/Wasm/AMDGPU); language/target subkind audit must split these, never include/exclude entire BuiltinType.
QualType qualifiers can carry language-specific/address-space/ownership state and need per-value filtering without losing C++ qualifiers.

Attribute concrete classes are enumerated completely, but their C++ subject/target/spelling/language applicability and per-class fields are explicitly pending; no inferred C++ completeness claim for Attr.
Kind taxonomy gives generated names but no portable numeric IDs: wire kind names/IDs must be assigned and reserved independently; stable node IDs must not be raw pointer addresses.
Per-kind typed getter/field audit, structural edges, precision encodings, error/dependent/implicit state, ownership, empty-vs-absent semantics and production fixtures remain phase-two work.
Generated runtime kind catalogs do not include every concrete implementation subclass: DependentTypeOfExprType and DependentDecltypeType share parent TypeClass; supplemental class audit is required.
ObjC-prefixed attributes cannot be excluded solely by name: GNU C++ probes accepted ObjCNSObjectAttr and ObjCBridgeAttr. All attribute eligibility remains under audit.
representation: Inline semantic values and named symbol descriptions; no opaque node handles or source occurrences
